name: @psyb0t/talkies
summary: Wire an OpenClaw agent to a self-hosted talkies speech API over MCP — ASR transcription and file staging as tools.
description: A thin stdio<->HTTP bridge that connects an MCP client (OpenClaw, Claude, Cursor, Codex, ...) to a running talkies instance's MCP endpoint (/v1/mcp), exposing its 6 tools: list_models (discover ASR slugs), transcribe (run ASR on a URL or staged file), list_files, put_file, get_file, and delete_file (server-side file staging). talkies is self-hosted — you run the server yourself and point this bridge at it. See https://github.com/psyb0t/docker-talkies.

TALKIES_URL.description: Base URL of your running talkies server, e.g. http://localhost:8000 (the bridge appends /v1/mcp).

TALKIES_AUTH_TOKEN.description: Bearer token, only if the talkies server was started with TALKIES_AUTH_TOKEN set.

url.description: Base URL of your running talkies server, e.g. http://localhost:8000 (the bridge appends /v1/mcp).

authToken.description: Bearer token, only if the talkies server was started with TALKIES_AUTH_TOKEN set.
